Hero.title: We run the busywork. You run the shop.
Hero.description: Call it an AI operating layer for small business — site, social, and content, handled daily. Plans from $20/mo.

Features.section_description: We combine hands-on expertise with smart tools to cover every corner of your online presence.
Features.feature1_description: We build tailor-made web and mobile applications designed around your specific workflows — no templates, no cookie-cutter builds. Your app, your rules.
Features.feature2_description: From logos and brand kits to social graphics and marketing materials, we create visuals that make your business instantly recognizable and professionally presented.
Features.feature3_description: We handle your content calendar, post creation, scheduling, and channel strategy across multiple networks so you stay consistent online without the daily grind.
Features.feature4_description: We script, shoot, and edit short-form video — Reels, Shorts, and TikToks — that bring people through your door.
Features.feature5_description: We produce written and visual content tuned for your audience — from blog posts and captions to short-form video scripts that drive real engagement.
Features.feature6_description: We build AI into the systems you already run — chatbots that answer from your real documents, paperwork that processes itself, and customer intake that routes to a human when it should.

Pricing.section_title: Choose the Right Plan for Your Business
Pricing.section_description: Flexible options for businesses at every stage — from just getting started to going full-service.

items.question: What makes your social media management unique?
items.answer: We combine human strategy with AI-assisted content to keep your brand visible across channels — tailored to your voice, without you lifting a finger.

items.question: Will the posts include graphics?
items.answer: Yes. All social media posts include custom-designed graphics matched to your brand identity.

items.question: Can I request custom post designs?
items.answer: Yes, all plans include custom-designed posts. Enterprise clients receive priority design requests and 3 custom videos per month.

items.question: How often will my social media be updated?
items.answer: Depending on your plan: Essentials gets 2 posts per week, Growth gets 2 posts per week across 3 platforms, Enterprise gets 4 posts per week across 4 platforms.

items.question: How often will you post Reels for me?
items.answer: On Growth and Enterprise plans we publish Reels 2–4 times per week — and adjust the calendar sooner if the numbers tell us something is not landing.

items.question: Do you respond to comments and messages?
items.answer: Our Enterprise plan includes community management. Essentials and Growth plans focus on content publishing.

items.question: What kind of AI automation do you build?
items.answer: We build AI into the systems you already use: chatbots that answer customer questions from your real documents, document processing that handles the paperwork, and intake that qualifies leads and hands off to a human when it should. Every build starts with a paid discovery sprint so you know exactly what you are getting before we write a line of code.

items.question: Can I cancel or upgrade my plan anytime?
items.answer: Yes. All plans are month-to-month with no long-term contracts. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel at any time.
